name: English
tagline: Daily, weekly and monthly horoscopes for every sign
privacy_description: Privacy Policy for Horoscope, the free daily, weekly and monthly horoscope app by Ariel Tkachenko.
summary_account: No account, no sign-up. The app never asks for your name, email or date of birth.
summary_texts: Horoscopes are downloaded from my own database. I don't keep a record of which signs or dates you read.
summary_no_analytics: The app collects no usage statistics.
summary_ads: The free version shows Google ads. You choose whether ads may be personalized and whether the app may track you.
summary_selling: I never sell your data. Buying Remove Ads turns ads off completely.
about_1: Horoscope (the “app”) is built and maintained by Ariel Tkachenko, an independent developer (“I”, “me”). The app is free to download and use, and is supported by ads.
about_2: This policy explains what information the app collects, why, who it's shared with, and the choices you have. By using the app, you agree to the collection and use of information as described here.
collect_intro: The app doesn't collect information that directly identifies you, such as your name, email address, phone number, date of birth or location. It works as follows:
texts_sign_in: Anonymous sign-in. To read the database, the app signs in anonymously with Firebase Authentication. Firebase assigns a random user ID that isn't linked to your identity, email or Apple Account. It's kept in the device's keychain, so it can survive reinstalling the app.
texts_requests: Horoscope texts are read from my Cloud Firestore database. Like any website, Google's servers receive your IP address and basic request details. The app only reads; it never writes anything about you to the database, and I don't keep a record of which signs, categories or dates you read.
texts_app_check: App integrity check (Firebase App Check). So that only the genuine app can read the database, the app proves its authenticity with Apple's App Attest service. This involves a key generated on your device, not information about you.
texts_cache: On your device. Texts you've opened are cached on the device, so they can be shown again without a connection. Your choices in the app (sign, category, date) are never sent anywhere.
sources: Russian horoscopes come from Ignio.com, English ones from FreeHoroscopeAPI. My server copies them into the database once a day. The app never contacts these sources itself, so they receive nothing about you.
no_analytics: The app has no analytics. It doesn't record which screens you open or what you read.
ads_intro: The free version shows a banner ad from Google AdMob. To show and measure ads, Google may collect your IP address, device and app information, ad interactions and, if you allow it, your device's advertising identifier (IDFA).
ads_consent: Consent (EEA, UK, Switzerland and some US states). Where the law requires it, the app shows Google's consent form before any ads load. You can choose whether your data may be used for personalized ads, and change your choice at any time from Privacy Settings in the app's Settings.
ads_tracking: App Tracking Transparency. iOS asks whether the app may track you across apps and websites owned by other companies. If you choose “Ask App Not to Track”, the advertising identifier isn't shared and you'll see non-personalized ads. You can change this anytime in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking.
ads_remove: Remove Ads. If you buy Remove Ads, the app doesn't load ads, show the consent form or the tracking prompt at all.
ads_more: Learn more in how Google uses information from apps that use its services.
purchases: The optional Remove Ads purchase is processed entirely by Apple through the App Store. I don't receive your name, Apple Account or payment details. The app only checks with Apple whether the purchase is active on your account, so it can be restored on your other devices.
third_parties_intro: These services process data on the app's behalf, each under its own privacy policy:
purpose_firebase: Anonymous sign-in, app integrity check, horoscope database
third_parties_servers: Google processes data on servers worldwide, including in the United States, under its standard data-protection safeguards.
sharing_intro: I do not sell, rent or trade your information. It's shared only:
sharing_providers: With the service providers listed above, to run the app and show ads (under your ad choices)
sharing_law: When required by law, or to protect the rights and safety of users or others
retention_account: The anonymous user ID stays in Firebase Authentication. Nothing else is stored with it.
retention_logs: Request details that Google's servers handle are kept by Google as described in its privacy policy; I don't keep logs of what you read.
retention_ads: Ad data is retained by Google as described in its privacy policy.
security: Data sent to Firebase and Google is encrypted in transit (HTTPS), the database can only be read by the genuine app, and access to the Firebase project is restricted. However, no method of transmission over the internet or of electronic storage is 100% secure, so I can't guarantee absolute security.
rights_intro: You're in control of what's collected:
rights_ads: Personalized ads: change your choice from Privacy Settings in the app's Settings (where available in your region).
rights_tracking: Tracking: turn it off in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking.
rights_everything: Everything: uninstalling the app stops all collection.
rights_law: Depending on where you live (for example, under the GDPR in the EU/UK or the CCPA in California), you also have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to object to or restrict its processing, and to complain to your local data-protection authority.
rights_requests: Because the app has no accounts and uses only a random identifier, I usually can't match stored data to a specific person. If you'd like to make a request, email me and I'll do my best to help within 30 days.
rights_basis: Legal basis (EEA/UK): Anonymous sign-in and the app integrity check are processed on the basis of my legitimate interest in running the app and protecting its database. Personalized ads are shown only with your consent.
children: The app isn't directed at children under 13, and I don't knowingly collect personal information from them. If you're a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal information, please contact me and I'll delete it.
changes: I may update this policy from time to time, for example when the app gains new features. Changes are posted on this page with a new “Last updated” date and take effect as soon as they're posted.
english_prevails: If the versions differ, the English version prevails.
contact_intro: Questions, requests or suggestions about this Privacy Policy? Get in touch:
support_description: Help and contact for Horoscope, the daily, weekly and monthly horoscope app.
support_summary: I read every message and usually answer within a few days. Please mention your device and iOS version.
q_restore: I bought Remove Ads. How do I get it on another device, or after reinstalling?
a_restore: Use the same Apple Account, and the app usually recognizes the purchase by itself, including purchases made in earlier versions of the app. If ads still show, open Settings (the gear on the list of signs) and tap Restore Purchases. There’s nothing to pay again.
q_language: How do I switch between Russian and English horoscopes?
a_language: The horoscopes follow the app’s language: in Russian you get Russian horoscopes, in any other language English ones. To change it, open iOS Settings → Apps → Horoscope → Language.
q_choices: Why are there more categories and days in Russian than in English?
a_choices: Each language has its own source, and the app shows exactly what that source provides. The Russian source has several categories (love, business, health and more) for yesterday through the day after tomorrow, plus weekly horoscopes. The English source has a general daily, weekly and monthly horoscope, published one day at a time; earlier days stay available for several months.
a_loading: The app needs an internet connection to download new texts. Horoscopes you’ve already opened are kept on the device and shown even offline. If the problem continues, pull down the list of signs to refresh, or email me.
q_sources: Where do the horoscopes come from?
a_sources: Russian horoscopes come from Ignio.com, English ones from FreeHoroscopeAPI. They are shown unchanged, and each text links to its source.
q_consent: Why am I asked about ads and tracking?
a_consent: In some regions the law requires asking before ads can be personalized, so Google’s consent form appears first. iOS asks about tracking only if you allowed personalized ads. You can change your choice anytime under Privacy Settings in the app’s Settings (where available), and Remove Ads turns ads off entirely. Details are in the Privacy Policy.
